description: Expected degradation behavior baselines for the xuansto-mcp-server

inline.description: Script-based checks degraded to inline implementations

indicators.features: Reduced accuracy, no external tool integration

sqlite_fts5.description: ChromaDB unavailable, using SQLite FTS5 for search

indicators.features: Keyword-based search only, no semantic understanding

keyword_fallback.description: Both ChromaDB and SQLite FTS5 unavailable, using keyword search

indicators.features: Basic keyword matching only, no relevance scoring

security_scan.trigger: Script not found or execution error

degradation_tracking.recovery: Automatic recovery when service becomes available again (e.g., ChromDB health check clears degradation count)

chromadb_degradation.behavior: When degradation count > 0, semantic search is skipped entirely
chromadb_degradation.recovery: ChromaDB health check resets count to 0 on successful connection

pre_hook_blocking.description: Pre-hooks can block tool execution by returning status='block'

post_hook_modification.description: Post-hooks can modify tool results or log decisions

expected_behavior.security_scan_without_chromadb: Returns inline scan results with degradation_level='inline'
expected_behavior.knowledge_search_without_chromadb: Falls back to SQLite FTS5, then keyword search
expected_behavior.hook_without_script: Falls back to inline hook logic
expected_behavior.quality_gate_without_script: Falls back to inline check or marks as SKIP
